job: ห้องพักกระจุกอยู่ตรงไหน และใกล้รถไฟฟ้าแค่ไหน — แล้วเจาะลงถึงสถานี โรงแรม และคู่เทียบ
audiences: ทีมพัฒนาโครงการและนักลงทุนที่ดิน/โรงแรม
ทีมขยายเครือและ revenue ของผู้ประกอบการโรงแรม
หน่วยงานท่องเที่ยว จังหวัด และ อปท.
ผู้ประเมินมูลค่าและสถาบันการเงิน
journey: switch the measure (ห้องพัก | ที่พัก)
district → groups, sizes, stations, chains, hotels
hotel → building view, facts, comparison set
changesSince: 0.3.3 (2026-11-02, owner “… ทำให้มันตอบทันเลยได้มั้ย”): ถาม Google AI opens a plain Google Search for the question of the view — answered at the top by Google’s AI Overview, AI Mode one tab away — instead of a link straight into AI Mode (udm=50), which Google stops at “Continue with this search?” whenever it comes from another site; Google’s answers never enter the data (prices only from recorded prices or dated observations). 0.3.2 (2026-11-02, owner “เวลาคลิกที่ poi hotel แล้วต้องแสดง 2-point perspective ของ 3d building mass ทุกกรณีสิ”): every stay with a point opens the two-point view of a 3D building — the drawn building whose outline holds the pin, else the drawn building nearest the pin within 300 m (loaded once more for 800 m when nothing is drawn within 300 m; legend “อาคารใกล้หมุด”, the pin in the frame; a camera choice, never a join); choosing a stay or a building switches the map to 3D; on terrain the camera lands on the ground after every ease (MapLibre 5.6.2 left it frozen), the x-ray walls end at the lowest ground under the building and the fit frames base and roof as drawn (three refits); a shift lens puts the camera straight at the building on a phone too, and a camera MapLibre would lift out of a hillside turns to another corner. 0.3.1 (2026-11-01, owner “เรื่องภาษา … กระชับอ่านเข้าใจง่าย ใช้ symbol, logo, icon, charts … ไม่มี caveats เลย และเป็นธรรมชาติ”): copy rewritten in the ICP's words — pictograms (rank, date, distance, construction, dataset added to the approved subset), the rail comparison as two bars, unknown rooms as a hatched size bar, the comparison rule as chips, no caveat on screen; one provenance line per view (dataset · source · date · boundary, then “วิธีนับ” → DATA_METHOD.md, where the limits live); the Aha and district shares use the province's whole total (53,516 / 153,200 = 35%). 0.3.0 (2026-11-01, owner point 3 and “อยากให้เห็นอาคารบนภูมิประเทศ”): buildings per อปท. (Bangkok: เขต) — CityMETER Building V4 where it holds ≥ 1.15 × the OpenStreetMap buildings of the unit, else OSM (3,900 of 3,947 units on CityMETER; data/building-units/), OSM buildings mapped in parts kept (LOD2), CityMETER heights called estimates and credited in the attribution; buildings stand on the terrain in the building view (the site's relief decides; the camera, x-ray and pins on the drawn ground; terrain set only while the camera is still). 0.2.0: symbol area by recorded rooms (hollow = unknown); names near the middle of the view ranked by recorded rooms and price, with chain-brand logos (107 of 112 brands, SHA-256 checked); hover card and panel icon chips incl. terrain facts; terrain mode at hilly sites (3D ground × 1.5, hillshade, district fill hard-switch at 12.5); legend, status and district chips use symbols; data refreshed with 47_ROOM_RESOLUTION (rooms 1,033,157; unknown 79) and 48_LOGO_LIBRARY brand identities. 0.1.0: first release from the CityMETER Fitness demo 0.3.1 (montri-th/fitness @50ec2b6).

rowScopes.scopeRows: rows after search · group · size · province · chain, before any district selection or focus: the comparison base of the Aha, the choropleth, the charts and every rank
rowScopes.baseRows: scopeRows narrowed by the selected เขต/อำเภอ
rowScopes.rows: baseRows narrowed by the district focus: pins with detail, counters, the table (a building or station panel shows its own rows)

firstAha.ranking: เขต/อำเภอ by the measure (then the other measure, then name) inside the home province = the province holding the most of the measure among rows placed at district level; up to three and never every district holding the measure (N ≤ 3 → top N − 1); never cut through a tie; none left → spread
firstAha.headlineTemplate: {share}% ของ{ห้องพัก|ที่พัก}{home} อยู่ใน {n} {เขต|อำเภอ}นี้ (one district: อยู่ใน{เขต|อำเภอ}{name})
firstAha.numerator: Σ measure of the focused districts (matched membership)
firstAha.denominator: Σ measure of every row of the home province in the selection (homeValue: rows with a district and rows placed only at province level; since 0.3.1)
firstAha.personality: rail: two bars — share of the measure within 500 m (straight line) of an operating CityMETER Transit station among the focus rows with a point vs the rest of the province’s placed rows with a point; both bases in each bar’s title and accessible text; hidden when neither side has any
firstAha.secondaryFinding: district(s) with the most of the measure outside the home province (every district tied); “อันดับ 1 นอก{home}”, “มากกว่าทุก{เขต}ของ{home}” when it exceeds the first focus district; hidden with a province filter and when the top is < 2
firstAha.defaultCamera: city preset, fitPitched over the focused districts
firstAha.action: ดูทุกพื้นที่ (?areas=all); เปรียบเทียบพื้นที่ (opens charts); district names are links

areas.name: เมืองภูเก็ต

outside.name: เมืองเชียงใหม่

fallbacks.spread: every district of the home province holds the same value → spread finding, the camera frames them
fallbacks.unplaced: no district can be ranked → the count and a table action

countingUnitContract.default: rooms recorded (Σ rooms_selected, ห้อง)
countingUnitContract.rule: one row = one row of 01_VENUES (source-listed record, operation not revalidated); unknown rooms counted apart, never 0; the alias row is out of every figure

metricContract.areas: Σ measure per เขต/อำเภอ (rooms → LI li.supply; records → LDS count)
metricContract.provinces: Σ measure per province frame (same family)
metricContract.eligibility: none — totals; ties are never cut (firstAha.ranking)
metricContract.combined: Σ focus ÷ the home province’s whole total in the selection (homeValue: placed and province-only rows, since 0.3.1; a share, numerator and denominator shown)
metricContract.notDrawn: no per-area or per-person ratio: recorded rooms are not a density or a market measure
metricContract.ramp: all 41 samples of the family LUT by rank among the measured nonzero values being read (js/scales.js#buildRamp; owner standing rule “Color scale ขอให้ใช้ 41 scales ตาม LDS เสมอ”); map, legend, labels, rank bars and the district chart read one ramp; the matrix has its own ramp over its cells

coverageContract.covered: every เขต/อำเภอ of the 77 provinces is in the register’s national scope

states.measured_zero: sample 0 + zero outline — no record of the dataset is placed there under the filters
states.no_data: rooms only: the district has records but none with known rooms (hatch)

coverageContract.unplaced: rows without a district are counted apart (province only, conflict), never shown as 0

apartment.th: อพาร์ตเมนต์และเซอร์วิสอพาร์ตเมนต์

guesthouse.th: เกสต์เฮาส์และโฮสเทล

other.th: ที่พักอื่น

categoricalCueContract.sizeCue: symbol area ∝ recorded rooms (radius = k(zoom)·√(rooms/100), cap 1,500, min 1.6 px; js/model.js#pinRadius); unknown rooms = open outline at the 50-room size; colour stays the group’s; quiet context ≤ 6 px radius

framesContract.index: data/area-index.json — 928 districts and 77 provinces, no geometry (codes, names, production areaSqm, label, bbox)
framesContract.frames: data/frames/{CODE}.json — district outlines per province (77 files)
framesContract.loading: the selection’s provinces at once; the provinces under the map at district zoom (≤ 6 per move); never all 77 up front; versioned with the release tag
framesContract.failure: reported and retried on the next request; panels, charts and table never depend on outlines

mapFocusContract.principle: detail only for the focused part — the selected district, the station, the hotel, the automatic or explicit focus; everything else visible but quiet

states.auto: default top districts; released when none of them is on screen

mapFocusContract.choropleth: li.supply (rooms) or count (records), 41-sample ramp by rank, under the basemap’s first line layer; zoom 8–14.5; the selected จังหวัด from zoom 4; measured_zero = sample 0 + 2 px zero outline; no_data = hatch

source.rule: operating = on the operator roster of CityMETER · Transit; construction = a project station, not a service; straight-line distance from the hotel point to the station reference point, up to 2000 m

rail.drawn: operating stations as quiet rings from zoom 10.5 (names from 13.5), clickable → station panel; the open station’s 500 m radius dashed
rail.hotel: nearest operating station within 2 km and nearest station under construction (words only)

groups.mall: ศูนย์การค้า

contextContract.inBuilding: 16_BRANCH_SPATIAL_CANDIDATES qualified spatial_candidate_requires_identity_review: a branch of another CityMETER research dataset whose source point falls in the same research building mass; not a tenancy, floor or located-in claim
contextContract.distances: straight lines between reference points — never a walking route, travel time or catchment

compsetContract.around: every record within 2,000 m (any group) with rooms and unknown count
compsetContract.words: คู่เทียบ · rule as chips (ประเภท · ½–2× ห้อง · ≤ 2 กม.); never คู่แข่ง; the limits live behind “วิธีนับ” (owner 2026-11-01: no caveat on screen)

priceContract.shown: per hotel only: fact chip, panel facts, comparison set, table
priceContract.words: chip “฿x–y ที่บันทึก” · source details “ราคาที่บันทึก … ต่อคืน · CityMETER Hotel V3” and “วันที่ราคา · ไม่ระบุในแหล่ง” (owner 2026-11-01: no caveat line)

contextActionsContract.ai: Google Search with a question written for the view (0.3.3: /search?q=, answered at the top by Google’s AI Overview, AI Mode one tab away; never udm=50, which Google stops at “Continue with this search?” from another site)
contextActionsContract.maps: Google Maps search by public names
contextActionsContract.streetView: only with a point (hotel point, station reference point “ใกล้สถานี”)
contextActionsContract.note: เปิดใน Google · ผลลัพธ์ไม่ใช่ข้อมูล CityMETER

buildingJoinContract.buildings: focus-tier footprints: OpenStreetMap (pieces of one outline cut by tile edges, building:parts, podium + tower grouped) or, inside a CityMETER unit, CityMETER Building V4 (whole buildings, keys cm:)
buildingJoinContract.click: one hotel → the hotel; several → the building panel “ที่พักในอาคารนี้” (“สูงราว”, the outline source in the title and the provenance line)
buildingJoinContract.nearest: 0.3.2: a hotel whose point falls in no outline is framed on the nearest drawn building (cameraContract.buildingView.target) — never joined, counted or listed in “ที่พักในอาคารนี้”

interactionContract.mapClicks: focus pin → the building being looked at (x-ray: frame again) → focus building → station → province view district / province frame (below zoom 8) → district
interactionContract.reframe: every way into a building view frames it again
interactionContract.keyboard: roving tabindex over HTML pins from zoom 15.5; roving tablist for chart views; arrow keys on the measure switch; visible focus everywhere

basemapContract.palette: --basemap-* tokens of assets/theme.css; data colours never set there

massingContract.cityTier: basemap building extrusions, quiet, faded with distance from the focus; OpenFreeMap features replaced by CityMETER buildings are hidden (one hashed match) and their buildings outside the focus come back in a context layer drawn the same way
massingContract.focusTier: rounded footprints from z14 tiles in the focus regions (≤ 16 tiles nearest the camera; from zoom 12 in 3D when complete, else 13): OpenStreetMap, or CityMETER Building V4 tiles (≤ 40 requests, per อปท. or แขวง) inside CityMETER units
massingContract.hostTier: unused (no host geometry in this product)
massingContract.enclosure: encloseOffsetM keeps the rounded shape around the original outline
massingContract.buildingSource: per unit from data/building-units/ (scripts/build-building-units.py): CityMETER Building V4 when its count ≥ 1.15 × the OSM count of the unit (owner 2026-11-01), else OSM; OSM buildings mapped in parts stay inside CityMETER units; a missing CityMETER tile leaves its part on OSM
massingContract.terrain: fill-extrusions stand on the terrain at their centroid (MapLibre); the building camera fits on the anchor's ground plane and the landed centre's ground; the x-ray solid is lifted the same way

presets.model: pitch 60 · fov 14 (district, hotel without a point)
presets.eye: pitch 75 · fov 24 (the building view: venue, building, hotel with a point)

cameraContract.fitting: fitPitched (overview, district): flat fit, then zoom out until every outline vertex is inside the padded viewport, then in while it still fits; pitch ≤ 90 − fov/2 − 3

buildingView.owner: 2026-10-29 19:47 “อาคารที่เลือก หรือ on focus ให้แสดงด้วยมุมมอง 2-point perspective เสมอ zoom to fit viewport เสมอด้วย”
buildingView.module: js/camera.js#fitBuilding, twoPointBearing, wallAzimuth, occlusionScore, screenBounds (from CityMETER · Shopping centers); js/app.js#frameFocus
buildingView.target: js/app.js#focusTarget — the open building; the building the open venue’s registry point falls in; the building the open hotel’s point falls in, else (0.3.2, owner 2026-11-02 “เวลาคลิกที่ poi hotel แล้วต้องแสดง 2-point perspective ของ 3d building mass ทุกกรณีสิ”) the drawn building nearest the hotel’s point: js/building-join.js#nearestBuilding — distance from the point to the outline on a local plane, within 300 m (HOTEL_REACH_M), the largest piece within 10 m of the nearest; when nothing is drawn within 300 m the focus tier is loaded once more for 800 m round the point (HOTEL_REACH_FAR_M); legend “อาคารใกล้หมุด”, framed with the point (one zoom step wider, maxZoom 20); a camera choice only, never a join, a count or a located-in claim
buildingView.bearing: dominant wall azimuth + 45°, on the diagonal where the drawn focus buildings (massing.obstaclesNear, 400 m) hide least of it, then the one nearest the current bearing
buildingView.fit: eye preset; shift lens (0.3.2, js/camera.js#lensPadding): padding moves the principal point up to the free box’s centre, never below the canvas centre (pitch + fov/2 < 90 keeps the horizon out), so the camera looks straight at the building at pitch 75 on a phone’s strip above the sheet as on a desktop; fit points = the pieces as the focus tier draws them at building zoom (massing.fitPointsOf → js/massing.js#footprintFitPoints: the offset and fillets of zoom 18, ground and roof), never the shape drawn at the starting zoom (up to 3.6 m wider on every side); every one inside the free box (js/app.js#visibleBox: below the toolbar, above the Aha card, legend, chart tray, table or open phone sheet, left of the zoom control), one side filling 94% of it; maxZoom 21 when the building is known (js/camera.js#BUILDING_MAX_ZOOM — Hotel hotels stand in shophouses and small buildings; the Shopping centers limit 19.5 left a 40 m building at half the box) / 18 while unknown, minZoom 14
buildingView.unknown: a 90 m box round the point (12 m tall) framed the same way while the buildings load, and where nothing is drawn within 800 m; the camera turns to the building when it arrives, at most three times, never after a user camera move
buildingView.plan: 3D off: the same footprint fitted flat (fitPitched plan, maxZoom 21 known / 18 unknown)
buildingView.click: selectHotel (pin, label, list row, search) and selectBuilding switch the map to 3D (js/app.js#ensure3d) before framing; a link keeps view3d=0 when it asks for it
buildingView.terrain: on terrain each fit point carries the ground it is drawn on (4th value: roof at the piece centroid’s ground, base at the lowest ground under its outline, the pin at its own ground); fitBuilding damps its landed rounds (half steps) and js/maplibre-guard.js#guardElevationFreeze lands the centre on the ground after every programmatic ease (MapLibre 5.6.2 leaves map._elevationFreeze on); refitted when the ground changes by ≥ 3 m, a new building arrives or the free box changes once the camera is still (js/app.js#watchFreeBox: legend, trays, phone sheet), at most 3 times, never after a user camera move
buildingView.lift: 0.3.2: MapLibre 5.6.2 lifts a camera that would stand inside the terrain (Map#_elevateCameraIfInsideTerrain: lower pitch, other zoom) on every jump; fitBuilding computes with it off (withoutLift) and asks MapLibre’s own check about the camera it found — the alternates (the other corners, opposite first: js/app.js#frameFocus) when that camera would be lifted, else the pitch MapLibre allows; the target carries its pitch and the centre’s elevation (an instant jump checks from the right height)

tileCoverGuard.bug: MapLibre GL JS 5.6.2 SourceCache._updateRetainedTiles checks the four children of a missing ideal tile whenever the cover zoom + 1 ≤ the source maxzoom; a pitched cover can already hold an ideal tile at the maxzoom, whose children() is ONE overscaled child; when that child is retained, children[1] is undefined and the frame throws “Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'key')”
tileCoverGuard.seen: live 2026-10-29 (Claude desktop browser, real OpenFreeMap tiles): openmaptiles (vector, maxzoom 14), cover zoom 13, camera 13.79–13.95, pitch 75, while the building camera flew between branches; reproduced in the build container by stepping the pitched camera out from 19.5 to 13.6 over a building (7–8 errors on 0.2.0, 0 with the guard)
tileCoverGuard.fix: pad the child list of exactly those ideal tiles to four copies of the overscaled child, so the check reads as MapLibre's own overzoom branch; installed on the shared SourceCache prototype at every style load; only for version 5.6.2
tileCoverGuard.elevationFreeze: js/maplibre-guard.js#guardElevationFreeze(map, version), 0.3.2: MapLibre 5.6.2 easeTo/flyTo on terrain without freezeElevation leave map._elevationFreeze on (only a gesture or _finalizeElevation clears it), so the render loop stops clamping the centre to the ground and the framed building drifts (seen 2026-11-02: camera 80.97 m vs ground 62.41 m at Sri Panwa); the guard wraps map._afterEase: when the ease ended (not superseded) and no terrain gesture is running, it clears the freeze and sets the centre elevation to the ground; only for version 5.6.2 (tests/maplibre-guard.test.js)

venueXrayContract.owner: 2026-10-29 19:47 “เช็คอย่าให้ 3d building mass ตึกอื่นบังอาคารที่กำลังดูอยู่”
venueXrayContract.module: js/venue-xray.js#installVenueXray(map, {beforeId, toMercator, colors}) → {update(features, {colors}), setEnabled, hitTest(point), dispose, count, enabled, failed} (from CityMETER · Shopping centers / Luxury Brands)
venueXrayContract.layer: venue-xray (custom, renderingMode 3d) before place-quarter (js/map-style.js#VENUE_XRAY_BEFORE): drawn over every building and over road names
venueXrayContract.input: the features of the building being looked at (massing.featuresOf(target.refs)) with display_height_m / display_base_m; on terrain the roof is lifted by the ground at the piece centroid (as MapLibre lifts fill-extrusions) and the walls go down to the lowest ground under the outline (0.3.2; a fixed 10 m showed through the slope)
venueXrayContract.depth: scissored depth clear inside the building’s screen box, then its own depth test
venueXrayContract.seeThrough: massing.setScene('eye', rings): the focus buildings standing in front of it turn see-through (SCENE.eye)
venueXrayContract.labels: district label chips never sit on the building (refreshLabelView avoid box); since 0.3.2 neither do the stays’ name labels (js/labels.js#installHotelLabels avoid → buildingScreenBox)
venueXrayContract.visibility: 3D only, zoom ≥ 13 (XRAY_MIN_ZOOM); empty outside the building view
venueXrayContract.colours: map.activeLayer faces, map.selectedStroke edges — map roles, not data colours
venueXrayContract.failSafe: a GL error disables it (failed = true); the massing highlight keeps drawing
venueXrayContract.geojsonMaxzoom: every GeoJSON source uses maxzoom 24 (js/map-layers.js#GEOJSON_MAXZOOM, the most geojson-vt allows), two levels above BUILDING_MAX_ZOOM: MapLibre 5.6.2 throws in SourceCache._updateRetainedTiles when the near tiles of a pitched cover reach a GeoJSON source maxzoom before they have data (seen in CityMETER · Shopping centers 2026-10-25); under the eye preset the near tiles sit up to about half a level above the camera (tests/release.test.js)

provinceContract.fill: the measure below zoom 8 without a province filter
